summary: Narrow treed lane edged by bush; nowhere to pull off and houses close.
reasons: No room to pull off the lane
No Stopping Any Time signs at both ends
Houses within about 11-15 m across the lane

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the south side, but houses and pools sit about 11-15 m away across the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane under canopy; the south edge is bush or bank with no verge or pull-off, and no cars parked.
drivers.convention: No parked cars and no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Signs: No Stopping Any Time at both ends of the stretch
Slope flat at 35-55 m; the upper part is steep (20% max)
sun_shade: Dense tree cover over the whole section, shade all day.
cannot_judge: Exact lane width under the canopy

best_section.where: Lower end of the narrow lane, south edge beside the bush
